article.story: FORT WAYNE, Ind. -- — Mikale Stevenson's 34 points led Purdue Fort Wayne over Milwaukee 100-82 on Sunday. Stevenson also contributed six assists for the Mastodons (12-8, 6-3 Horizon League). DeAndre Craig had 20 points, eight rebounds, five assists, and three steals while shooting 5 for 15 (3 for 6 from 3-point range) and 7 of 8 from the free-throw line. Corey Hadnot II had 19 points and finished 8 of 12 from the field. Amar Augillard led the Panthers (8-12, 4-5) in scoring, finishing with 35 points. Josh Dixon added 13 points for Milwaukee. Stevie Elam finished with 11 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
